each.en: Each student received a different question to discuss with the group.
each.zh: 每位學生都拿到不同的問題與小組討論。

eager.en: She was eager to learn how the new device worked.
eager.zh: 她很想知道這個新裝置如何運作。

ear.en: The doctor examined his ear after he reported discomfort.
ear.zh: 他表示耳朵不舒服後，醫師檢查了他的耳朵。

early.en: We arrived early so we could prepare the room before class.
early.zh: 我們提早到達，好在上課前準備教室。

earn.en: Students can earn extra credit by completing the optional project.
earn.zh: 學生完成選做專題可以獲得額外加分。

earth.en: The earth moves around the sun once every year.
earth.zh: 地球每年繞太陽運行一圈。

earthquake.en: The earthquake damaged several older buildings in the city.
earthquake.zh: 這場地震損壞了城裡幾棟較老的建築。

ease.en: A clear schedule can ease stress before major exams.
ease.zh: 清楚的時間表能減輕大考前的壓力。

easily.en: This chart can be easily understood even without a long explanation.
easily.zh: 即使沒有冗長說明，這張圖表也很容易理解。

east.en: The sun rises in the east every morning.
east.zh: 太陽每天早上從東方升起。

eastern.en: Heavy rain affected several towns along the eastern coast.
eastern.zh: 大雨影響了東部沿海的幾個城鎮。

easy.en: The first question was easy, but the last one was challenging.
easy.zh: 第一題很簡單，但最後一題很有挑戰性。

eat.en: We usually eat lunch together after the fourth class.
eat.zh: 我們通常第四節課後一起吃午餐。

economic.en: The report examines how economic changes affect young workers.
economic.zh: 這份報告探討經濟變化如何影響年輕工作者。

economy.en: Tourism plays an important role in the local economy.
economy.zh: 觀光在當地經濟中扮演重要角色。

edge.en: Do not stand too close to the edge of the platform.
edge.zh: 不要站得太靠近月台邊緣。

edit.en: Please edit your essay carefully before submitting the final version.
edit.zh: 提交最終版本前請仔細修改文章。

edition.en: The newest edition of the textbook includes updated examples.
edition.zh: 最新版教科書加入了更新的例子。

editor.en: The editor checked the article for unclear sentences and errors.
editor.zh: 編輯檢查文章中不清楚的句子和錯誤。

educate.en: Schools should educate students about responsible use of technology.
educate.zh: 學校應教育學生負責任地使用科技。

education.en: Education can provide people with more choices for the future.
education.zh: 教育能為人們的未來提供更多選擇。

educational.en: The museum offers educational programs for students of different ages.
educational.zh: 博物館為不同年齡的學生提供教育活動。

effect.en: The new study method had a positive effect on test performance.
effect.zh: 新的讀書方法對考試表現產生了正面效果。

effective.en: Regular review is more effective than studying everything at once.
effective.zh: 規律複習比一次把所有內容讀完更有效。

effectively.en: Students need to learn how to manage their time effectively.
effectively.zh: 學生需要學會如何有效管理時間。

efficiency.en: The new system improved efficiency by reducing repeated work.
efficiency.zh: 新系統透過減少重複工作提升效率。

efficient.en: This route is more efficient because it avoids heavy traffic.
efficient.zh: 這條路線因避開塞車而更有效率。

effort.en: Her improvement was the result of steady effort over several months.
effort.zh: 她的進步是數月持續努力的結果。

egg.en: She added an egg to the bowl before mixing the ingredients.
egg.zh: 她在攪拌材料前先在碗裡加入一顆蛋。

either.en: You can choose either topic for your final presentation.
either.zh: 期末報告兩個主題你可以任選一個。

elderly.en: The program helps elderly residents use smartphones more confidently.
elderly.zh: 這項計畫幫助年長居民更有信心地使用智慧型手機。

elect.en: Students will elect a new class representative next week.
elect.zh: 學生下週會選出新的班級代表。

election.en: The class election will take place during homeroom on Friday.
election.zh: 班級選舉會在星期五班會時間舉行。

electric.en: The school replaced an old bus with an electric one.
electric.zh: 學校用電動巴士取代了一輛老舊巴士。

electrical.en: Electrical equipment should be kept away from water.

electricity.en: The solar panels produce enough electricity for several classrooms.
electricity.zh: 這些太陽能板能為數間教室提供足夠電力。

electronic.en: Students submit most assignments through an electronic learning system.
electronic.zh: 學生大多透過電子學習系統繳交作業。

element.en: Trust is an important element of successful teamwork.
element.zh: 信任是成功團隊合作的重要要素。

elementary.en: The program introduces elementary coding skills to younger students.
elementary.zh: 這項計畫向年幼學生介紹基礎程式設計技能。

else.en: If this solution fails, we will need to try something else.
else.zh: 如果這個方法失敗，我們就得試別的方法。

email.en: Please send me an email if the meeting time changes.
email.zh: 如果會議時間改變，請寄電子郵件告訴我。

embarrass.en: The teacher tried not to embarrass the student in front of the class.
embarrass.zh: 老師盡量不讓那名學生在全班面前難堪。

emerge.en: A clear pattern began to emerge after we compared the results.
emerge.zh: 比較結果後，一個明顯的模式開始浮現。

emergency.en: The school practiced an emergency evacuation drill this morning.
emergency.zh: 學校今天早上進行了緊急疏散演練。

emotion.en: Music can strongly influence a person's emotion and memory.
emotion.zh: 音樂可以強烈影響人的情緒與記憶。

emotional.en: The ending of the film was emotional but not overly dramatic.
emotional.zh: 電影結尾很感人，但並不過度煽情。

emphasize.en: The teacher emphasized the importance of checking reliable sources.
emphasize.zh: 老師強調查證可靠來源的重要性。

employ.en: The company plans to employ more workers next year.
employ.zh: 這家公司計畫明年聘用更多員工。

employee.en: Each employee received training before using the new system.
employee.zh: 每位員工使用新系統前都接受了訓練。

employer.en: The employer offered flexible hours during the busy season.
employer.zh: 雇主在忙碌季節提供彈性工時。

employment.en: The report examines employment trends among recent graduates.
employment.zh: 這份報告探討近期畢業生的就業趨勢。

empty.en: The classroom was empty when I arrived after school.
empty.zh: 我放學後到達時，教室裡沒有人。

enable.en: This feature will enable students to study offline.
enable.zh: 這項功能能讓學生離線學習。

encourage.en: Teachers should encourage students to ask thoughtful questions.
encourage.zh: 老師應鼓勵學生提出經過思考的問題。

end.en: Please hand in your worksheet at the end of class.

enemy.en: The story follows two former enemies who eventually become friends.
enemy.zh: 故事描述兩個昔日敵人最後成為朋友。

energy.en: Solar energy can reduce dependence on fossil fuels.
energy.zh: 太陽能可以減少對化石燃料的依賴。

engage.en: Good questions can engage students in deeper discussion.
engage.zh: 好問題能讓學生投入更深入的討論。

engine.en: The mechanic checked the engine before the long trip.
engine.zh: 長途旅行前，技師檢查了引擎。

engineer.en: The engineer tested the bridge design before construction began.
engineer.zh: 工程師在施工前測試了橋梁設計。

engineering.en: She hopes to study engineering and design useful technology.
engineering.zh: 她希望學習工程並設計實用科技。

English.en: English is used in many international academic and business settings.
English.zh: 英文廣泛用於國際學術與商業場合。

enjoy.en: Many students enjoy learning through games and group activities.
enjoy.zh: 許多學生喜歡透過遊戲和小組活動學習。

enough.en: We have enough time to review the final chapter today.
enough.zh: 我們今天有足夠時間複習最後一章。

ensure.en: Please double-check the numbers to ensure the report is accurate.
ensure.zh: 請再次檢查數字，以確保報告正確。

enter.en: Students must enter their ID number before starting the test.
enter.zh: 學生開始測驗前必須輸入學號。

entertain.en: The speaker used a funny story to entertain the audience.
entertain.zh: 講者用一個有趣故事逗樂觀眾。

entertainment.en: The festival offers music, food, and entertainment for families.
entertainment.zh: 這個節慶提供音樂、美食和適合家庭的娛樂活動。

entire.en: The entire class worked together to finish the project.
entire.zh: 全班一起合作完成了這項專題。

entrance.en: The main entrance is located beside the parking area.
entrance.zh: 主要入口位於停車區旁。

entry.en: Each contest entry must include a title and short description.
entry.zh: 每件參賽作品都必須附上標題和簡短說明。

environment.en: A quiet environment can help students concentrate for longer periods.
environment.zh: 安靜的環境能幫助學生更長時間保持專注。

environmental.en: The class discussed several environmental problems affecting local communities.
environmental.zh: 全班討論了幾個影響當地社區的環境問題。

equal.en: Each group should have an equal number of students.
equal.zh: 每個小組的人數應該相同。

equally.en: The prize money was divided equally among the four winners.
equally.zh: 獎金平均分給四位得獎者。

equipment.en: Students must return all equipment after finishing the experiment.
equipment.zh: 學生完成實驗後必須歸還所有器材。

error.en: A small error in the data changed the final result.
error.zh: 資料中的一個小錯誤改變了最後結果。

escape.en: The bird managed to escape through an open window.
escape.zh: 那隻鳥成功從打開的窗戶逃走。

especially.en: This chapter is especially important for the final exam.
especially.zh: 這一章對期末考尤其重要。

essay.en: Her essay presents a clear argument supported by strong evidence.
essay.zh: 她的文章提出清楚論點並有有力證據支持。

essential.en: Clean water is essential for human health and survival.
essential.zh: 乾淨的水對人類健康與生存至關重要。

establish.en: The school hopes to establish a stronger reading culture.
establish.zh: 學校希望建立更濃厚的閱讀風氣。

estimate.en: We estimate that the project will take about three weeks.
estimate.zh: 我們估計這項專題大約需要三週。

even.en: Even a short walk can help improve your mood.
even.zh: 即使只是短暫散步，也能幫助改善心情。

evening.en: The library stays open until nine in the evening.
evening.zh: 圖書館晚上開放到九點。

event.en: The school event attracted more visitors than expected.
event.zh: 這場校內活動吸引的訪客比預期多。

eventually.en: After several attempts, the team eventually solved the problem.
eventually.zh: 經過多次嘗試後，團隊最後解決了問題。

ever.en: Have you ever visited a science museum at night?
ever.zh: 你曾經在晚上參觀過科學博物館嗎？

every.en: Every student must bring a notebook to the workshop.
every.zh: 每位學生都必須帶筆記本參加工作坊。

everyone.en: Everyone in the group contributed at least one idea.
everyone.zh: 小組裡每個人都至少提出了一個想法。

everything.en: Please check that everything is ready before the presentation begins.
everything.zh: 報告開始前請確認所有東西都準備好了。

evidence.en: Strong evidence makes an argument more convincing.
evidence.zh: 有力的證據會讓論點更有說服力。

exact.en: Please write the exact number shown on the screen.
exact.zh: 請寫下螢幕上顯示的確切數字。

exactly.en: The experiment worked exactly as the teacher had predicted.
exactly.zh: 實驗結果和老師預測的完全一樣。

exam.en: She reviewed vocabulary every night before the exam.
exam.zh: 考試前她每天晚上都複習單字。

examine.en: Scientists examine the samples under a microscope.
examine.zh: 科學家用顯微鏡檢查樣本。

example.en: The teacher gave an example to explain the difficult grammar rule.
example.zh: 老師舉了一個例子來解釋困難的文法規則。

excellent.en: She received excellent feedback on her final presentation.
excellent.zh: 她的期末報告獲得了非常好的回饋。

except.en: Everyone attended the meeting except one student who was sick.
except.zh: 除了生病的一位學生外，所有人都參加了會議。

exchange.en: The school organized an exchange program with a partner school overseas.
exchange.zh: 學校與海外姊妹校舉辦交換計畫。

excite.en: The announcement will excite students who enjoy science competitions.
excite.zh: 這項公告會讓喜歡科學競賽的學生感到興奮。

excited.en: The students were excited about visiting the new exhibition.
excited.zh: 學生對參觀新展覽感到很興奮。

exciting.en: The final game was exciting from beginning to end.
exciting.zh: 最後一場比賽從頭到尾都很精彩。

exclude.en: The study will exclude responses that are incomplete or unclear.
exclude.zh: 這項研究會排除不完整或不清楚的回覆。

excuse.en: He gave a reasonable excuse for arriving late to class.
excuse.zh: 他為上課遲到提出了一個合理理由。

exercise.en: Regular exercise can improve both physical and mental health.
exercise.zh: 規律運動能改善身心健康。

exist.en: Several possible solutions exist for this problem.
exist.zh: 這個問題有數種可能的解決方法。

existence.en: The discovery confirmed the existence of water beneath the surface.
existence.zh: 這項發現證實了地表下有水存在。

expand.en: The school plans to expand the library next year.
expand.zh: 學校計畫明年擴建圖書館。

expect.en: We expect the results to improve after more practice.
expect.zh: 我們預期增加練習後結果會改善。

expectation.en: The final result was better than our original expectation.
expectation.zh: 最後結果比我們原先預期更好。

expensive.en: The new equipment is expensive but more reliable.
expensive.zh: 新設備很昂貴，但更可靠。

experience.en: Volunteering gave her useful experience in working with children.
experience.zh: 志工服務讓她獲得與兒童相處的實用經驗。

experiment.en: The experiment tested how light affects plant growth.
experiment.zh: 這項實驗測試光線如何影響植物生長。

expert.en: The school invited an expert to speak about climate change.
expert.zh: 學校邀請一位專家談氣候變遷。

explain.en: Please explain your answer using evidence from the passage.
explain.zh: 請用文章中的證據解釋你的答案。

explanation.en: Her explanation was clear enough for everyone to follow.
explanation.zh: 她的解釋很清楚，每個人都能理解。

explore.en: Students used the website to explore different career options.
explore.zh: 學生使用網站探索不同的職涯選擇。

export.en: The program can export the results as a spreadsheet file.
export.zh: 這個程式可以把結果匯出成試算表檔案。

express.en: Students should learn to express their ideas clearly and politely.
express.zh: 學生應學會清楚且有禮貌地表達想法。

expression.en: Her facial expression showed that she was surprised.
expression.zh: 她的臉部表情顯示她很驚訝。

extend.en: The teacher agreed to extend the deadline by two days.
extend.zh: 老師同意把截止日期延後兩天。

extra.en: We had extra time to check our answers before class ended.
extra.zh: 下課前我們有額外時間檢查答案。

eye.en: The bright light made it difficult to keep one eye open.
eye.zh: 強光讓人很難睜開一隻眼睛。

face.en: Students often face new challenges when they enter high school.
face.zh: 學生進入高中後常會面臨新的挑戰。

fact.en: Please separate each fact from personal opinion in your notes.
fact.zh: 請在筆記中把每項事實與個人意見分開。

factor.en: Sleep is an important factor in memory and concentration.
factor.zh: 睡眠是影響記憶與專注的重要因素。

factory.en: The factory installed new equipment to reduce energy use.
factory.zh: 這家工廠安裝新設備以降低能源使用。

fail.en: Do not be afraid to fail when trying something new.
fail.zh: 嘗試新事物時不要害怕失敗。

failure.en: The first failure helped the team improve its design.
failure.zh: 第一次失敗幫助團隊改進設計。

fair.en: The teacher used clear rules to make the competition fair.
fair.zh: 老師用明確規則讓比賽保持公平。

fairly.en: The teacher tried to grade every report fairly.
fairly.zh: 老師努力公平地評分每份報告。

fall.en: Temperatures usually fall quickly after sunset in the mountains.
fall.zh: 山區日落後氣溫通常會快速下降。

false.en: The article contained several false claims that lacked evidence.
false.zh: 這篇文章包含幾項缺乏證據的錯誤主張。

familiar.en: The topic became easier once the examples felt familiar.
familiar.zh: 例子變得熟悉後，這個主題就容易多了。

family.en: Her family supported her decision to study abroad.
family.zh: 她的家人支持她出國留學的決定。

famous.en: The city is famous for its night markets and local food.
famous.zh: 這座城市以夜市和在地美食聞名。

fan.en: A small fan helped keep the classroom cool.
fan.zh: 一台小風扇幫助教室保持涼爽。

far.en: The station is not far from the school entrance.

farm.en: The farm grows vegetables without using harmful chemicals.
farm.zh: 這座農場種植蔬菜時不使用有害化學物質。

farmer.en: The farmer checked the weather before planting the seeds.
farmer.zh: 農夫在播種前先查看天氣。

fast.en: The train is fast enough to reach the city in an hour.
fast.zh: 這班火車速度夠快，一小時就能到城市。

fat.en: The nutrition label shows how much fat the food contains.
fat.zh: 營養標示顯示這份食物含有多少脂肪。

father.en: Her father helped her repair the old bicycle.
father.zh: 她的父親幫她修理舊腳踏車。

fault.en: The technician found a fault in the electrical system.
fault.zh: 技師在電力系統中發現了一個故障。

favor.en: Could you do me a favor and carry these books?
favor.zh: 你可以幫我一個忙，拿這些書嗎？

favorite.en: Science is her favorite subject because she enjoys experiments.
favorite.zh: 自然科是她最喜歡的科目，因為她喜歡做實驗。

fear.en: Practice can reduce the fear of speaking in front of others.
fear.zh: 練習可以減少在眾人面前說話的恐懼。

feature.en: The app includes a useful feature for reviewing difficult words.
feature.zh: 這個應用程式有一項方便複習困難單字的功能。

February.en: The school trip is scheduled for the middle of February.
February.zh: 學校旅行安排在二月中旬。

fee.en: The museum charges a small entrance fee on weekends.
fee.zh: 博物館週末會收取少額入場費。

feed.en: Please do not feed the animals without permission.
feed.zh: 沒有許可請不要餵食動物。

feel.en: Most students feel more confident after enough practice.
feel.zh: 大多數學生充分練習後會更有自信。

feeling.en: She described the feeling of relief after finishing the exam.
feeling.zh: 她描述了考完試後如釋重負的感覺。

female.en: The study included an equal number of male and female participants.
female.zh: 這項研究的男性與女性參與者人數相同。

fence.en: A tall fence surrounds the school garden.
fence.zh: 一座高圍欄圍住了學校花園。

festival.en: The school festival includes performances, games, and food stalls.
festival.zh: 校慶包含表演、遊戲和美食攤位。

few.en: Only a few students finished the challenge on their first attempt.
few.zh: 只有少數學生第一次嘗試就完成挑戰。

field.en: The students collected soil samples from a nearby field.
field.zh: 學生從附近田地採集土壤樣本。

fight.en: The two characters fight at first but later become friends.
fight.zh: 兩個角色一開始爭鬥，後來卻成為朋友。

figure.en: The figure shows how the system changes over time.
figure.zh: 這張圖顯示系統如何隨時間改變。

file.en: Please save the file before turning off the computer.
file.zh: 關閉電腦前請先儲存檔案。

fill.en: Please fill the bottle with clean water before the trip.
fill.zh: 出發前請把瓶子裝滿乾淨的水。

film.en: The class watched a short film about ocean conservation.
film.zh: 全班看了一部關於海洋保育的短片。

final.en: The final question requires students to explain their reasoning.
final.zh: 最後一題要求學生解釋推理過程。

finally.en: After several revisions, the report was finally ready to submit.
finally.zh: 經過多次修改後，報告終於可以提交了。

finance.en: The course introduces basic ideas about personal finance and saving.
finance.zh: 這門課介紹個人理財與儲蓄的基本概念。

financial.en: The family made a financial plan before buying a new car.
financial.zh: 這個家庭買新車前先做了財務規劃。

find.en: You can find the answer by comparing the two paragraphs.
find.zh: 你可以比較這兩段來找到答案。

fine.en: The weather should be fine for tomorrow's outdoor activity.
fine.zh: 明天的戶外活動天氣應該不錯。

finger.en: He injured his finger while moving a heavy box.
finger.zh: 他搬重箱子時弄傷了手指。

finish.en: Please finish the first section before moving to the next one.
finish.zh: 請完成第一部分後再進入下一部分。

fire.en: The fire alarm sounded during the morning class.
fire.zh: 早上上課時火警警報響了。

firm.en: The school has a firm rule against cheating on tests.
firm.zh: 學校對考試作弊有嚴格規定。

first.en: Read the instructions first before answering any questions.
first.zh: 回答任何問題前請先閱讀說明。

fish.en: The river contains several species of freshwater fish.
fish.zh: 這條河裡有數種淡水魚。

fit.en: This schedule should fit most students' study routines.
fit.zh: 這個時間表應該能配合大多數學生的讀書作息。

fix.en: The technician came to fix the broken projector.
fix.zh: 技師來修理故障的投影機。

flag.en: The flag was raised before the ceremony began.
flag.zh: 典禮開始前旗幟被升起。

flat.en: The road remains flat for several kilometers after the bridge.
flat.zh: 過橋後道路有好幾公里都很平坦。

flight.en: Our flight was delayed because of strong winds.
flight.zh: 我們的班機因強風而延誤。

floor.en: The science laboratory is on the third floor.
floor.zh: 自然科實驗室位於三樓。

flower.en: The flower opened fully after several sunny days.
flower.zh: 經過幾個晴天後，這朵花完全綻放。

flow.en: The diagram shows how water can flow through the system.
flow.zh: 這張圖示顯示水如何流經系統。

fly.en: Some birds fly thousands of kilometers during seasonal migration.
fly.zh: 有些鳥類季節遷徙時會飛行數千公里。

focus.en: Try to focus on one task at a time while studying.
focus.zh: 讀書時盡量一次專注在一項任務上。

follow.en: Please follow the safety instructions during the experiment.
follow.zh: 實驗進行時請遵守安全說明。

food.en: The event provides food and drinks for all participants.
food.zh: 這場活動為所有參與者提供餐點和飲料。

foot.en: He hurt his foot while running on the wet field.
foot.zh: 他在濕滑的球場跑步時傷了腳。

football.en: The football team practices every Tuesday and Thursday.
football.zh: 足球隊每星期二和星期四練習。

for.en: This guide is designed for students preparing for the exam.
for.zh: 這份指南是為準備考試的學生設計的。

force.en: Strong winds forced the organizers to cancel the outdoor event.
force.zh: 強風迫使主辦單位取消戶外活動。

foreign.en: Learning a foreign language can broaden your view of the world.
foreign.zh: 學習外語可以拓展你對世界的看法。

forest.en: The forest provides habitat for many plants and animals.
forest.zh: 森林為許多動植物提供棲地。

forget.en: Do not forget to bring your student card tomorrow.
forget.zh: 明天不要忘記帶學生證。

form.en: Please complete the form and return it by Friday.
form.zh: 請填好表格並在星期五前繳回。

formal.en: Use formal language when writing an application letter.
formal.zh: 撰寫申請信時請使用正式語言。

former.en: The former principal returned to visit the school last week.
former.zh: 前任校長上週回學校參訪。

forward.en: Please move forward when your group is called.
forward.zh: 叫到你們小組時請往前移動。

free.en: The museum offers free admission to students on Wednesdays.
free.zh: 博物館星期三對學生免費開放。

freedom.en: The discussion focused on the balance between freedom and responsibility.
freedom.zh: 討論聚焦在自由與責任之間的平衡。

fresh.en: The market sells fresh fruit and vegetables every morning.
fresh.zh: 市場每天早上販售新鮮蔬果。

Friday.en: The final report is due this Friday afternoon.
Friday.zh: 期末報告本週五下午截止。

friend.en: A good friend can offer support during difficult times.
friend.zh: 好朋友能在困難時提供支持。

friendly.en: The staff were friendly and answered all our questions.
friendly.zh: 工作人員很友善，回答了我們所有問題。

from.en: Students from different classes worked together on the project.
from.zh: 來自不同班級的學生一起完成這項專題。

front.en: Please write your name on the front of the worksheet.
front.zh: 請把名字寫在學習單正面。

fruit.en: Fresh fruit is available in the school cafeteria every day.
fruit.zh: 學校餐廳每天都有新鮮水果。

full.en: The classroom was full before the lecture even started.
full.zh: 講座開始前教室就已經坐滿了。

fun.en: The activity was fun and also helped us learn new words.
fun.zh: 這項活動很有趣，也幫助我們學習新單字。

function.en: This button has a function that saves your progress automatically.
function.zh: 這個按鈕有自動儲存進度的功能。

fund.en: The school created a fund to support students with financial needs.
fund.zh: 學校設立基金幫助有經濟需求的學生。

future.en: She hopes to work in environmental science in the future.
future.zh: 她希望未來從事環境科學相關工作。
